name: pi packages
summary: The package format for the Pi coding agent, bundling extensions, skills, prompt templates and themes for sharing through npm or git. Packages install with pi install and are listed in a gallery on pi.dev when tagged with the pi-package keyword.
facts: Conventional dirs or a pi key in package.json
goodFor: Adding sub-agents, plan mode and tools to Pi
watchOut: Extensions run arbitrary code; review source
